## Window Header and Title Bar
- **Application Name**: Visual Studio Code
- **Window Title**: Welcome - project - Visual Studio Code
- **Date and Time Display**: Oct 23 01:59
- **System Tray Icons**: Located on the top-right corner
  - Minimize button (dash icon)
  - Maximize button (square icon)
  - Close button (X icon)
- **Application Menu Bar**: Located at the top, includes the following menu items:
  - File
  - Edit
  - Selection
  - View
  - Go
  - Run
  - Terminal
  - Help

## Desktop Environment and Application Dock
- **Desktop Environment**: Ubuntu (indicated by the "Activities" button on the top-left)
- **Application Dock**: Located on the left side of the screen, contains the following icons from top to bottom:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird Mail
  - Visual Studio Code (currently active)
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Ubuntu Software
  - Help (Question Mark icon)
  - Trash Can
- **Bottom Dock**: Contains a grid icon (app launcher) and a user profile icon

### Left Sidebar (Activity Bar)
- **Explorer Icon**: Folders and files icon
- **Search Icon**: Magnifying glass icon
- **Source Control Icon**: Branch and commit icon
- **Debug Icon**: Bug and arrow icon
- **Extensions Icon**: Square grid icon
- **Outline and Timeline Sections**: Located at the bottom of the sidebar
  - OUTLINE (collapsed)
  - TIMELINE (collapsed)

### Main Editor Area
- **Active Tab**: Welcome (with a close button 'X')
- **Welcome Page Content**:
  - **Title**: Visual Studio Code
  - **Subtitle**: Editing evolved
  - **Start Section**:
    - New File...
    - Open File...
    - Open Folder
    - Connect to...
  - **Recent Section**:
    - You have no recent files
  - **Walkthroughs Section**:
    - Started with VS Code
    - The Fundamentals
- **Trust Dialog Box**:
  - **Title**: Do you trust the authors of the files in this folder?
  - **Icon**: Blue shield with a keyhole
  - **Message**:
    - Code provides features that may automatically execute files in this folder.
    - If you don't trust the authors of these files, we recommend to continue in restricted mode as the files may be malicious. See our docs to learn more.
  - **Path**: ~/project
  - **Checkbox**:
    - Trust the authors of all files in the parent folder 'user'
  - **Buttons**:
    - No, I don't trust the authors (Browse folder in restricted mode)
    - Yes, I trust the authors (Trust folder and enable all features)

### Status Bar
- **Bottom Left Corner**:
  - **Git Status Indicators**: 0 commits, 0 changes, 0 conflicts
  - **User Profile Icon**: Located at the bottom-left corner
- **Bottom Right Corner**:
  - **Checkbox**: Show welcome page on startup (checked)
  - **Notification Bell Icon**: Located at the bottom-right corner

### Explorer Panel
- **Panel Title**: EXPLORER
- **Project Folder**: PROJECT (expanded)

  - test_text_search.py
  - text_search.py
